name: Wild Mana Lily
tooltip:
Wild Mana Lily
5 yd range
2.5 sec cast
Another recent offshoot species, mana lily is a new variant of mageroyal. The latent magic present in the Quel'Thalas region has seeped into the mana lily, giving them potent properties for crafting.

If you're ever gathering around bodies of water, you can expect to find mana lilies somewhere nearby.

Zul'Aman -- a land rife with natural magic and ancient power. This power permeates all things in Zul'Aman, and has come to affect the herbs found within the region.

Gathering these wild herbs releases a burst of nature magic, giving rise to a group of hostile herb lashers that attempt to take vengeance!

Discovery: Midnight Gathering Nodes
